title: Walking change distance
text: T-3298: riders change between two stations on foot only when they are under 300 m apart, unless a passage links them. So a tram stop 450 m from a train station gives no change at all (the trip walks 33 min to the train instead). Raise the limit to 600 m for every pair of stations, raise it only for tram stops to train stations, or keep 300 m and leave it to passages? Recommended: 600 m for all, after measuring search time and riders on the real save. It makes passages a bit less useful (they still reach 1 km).
